idle.label: Idle
idle.prompt: A person stands naturally with subtle breathing and small relaxed weight shifts.

listen.label: Listen
listen.prompt: A person stands attentively and listens with calm, subtle conversational body movement.

explain.label: Explain
explain.prompt: A person explains something naturally using relaxed conversational hand and arm gestures.

wave.label: Wave
wave.prompt: A person gives a natural friendly wave with the right hand while keeping the shoulder and torso relaxed.

jog_in_place.label: Jog in place
jog_in_place.prompt: A person jogs naturally in place with coordinated arm swings, grounded footfalls, and no forward travel.

run_in_place.label: Run in place
run_in_place.prompt: A person runs naturally in place with energetic coordinated arm and leg motion and no forward travel.

jumping_jacks.label: Jumping jacks
jumping_jacks.prompt: A person performs controlled jumping jacks in place with synchronized arms and legs and stable balance.

stretch.label: Stretch
stretch.prompt: A person performs a relaxed standing full-body stretch with smooth arm, shoulder, and torso movement.

dance_relaxed.label: Relaxed dance
dance_relaxed.prompt: A person performs a relaxed casual dance in place with natural rhythm, loose shoulders, and coordinated steps.
